title: What problems does petrol pump management software solve?
description: Petrol pump management software tackles stock variance, nozzle reading errors, unclear credit balances, slow daily closing, and weak financial visibility. Petroleu links sales, inventory, and accounts so owners catch leakage early and close each day with confidence.

title: What is nozzle reading in petrol pump software?
description: Nozzle reading means recording opening and closing meter values on each dispenser. Petrol pump software uses these readings to work out litres sold per nozzle, per shift, and per day — the basis for accurate sales and variance tracking.

title: How does Petroleu calculate nozzle sales?
description: Petroleu subtracts opening meter readings from closing readings for each nozzle. The difference gives litres sold, which is multiplied by the fuel rate for sale value. Results feed into shift and daily closing reports without manual calculation.

title: Can Petroleu manage multiple nozzles?
description: Petroleu supports multiple nozzles across petrol, diesel, and HOBC dispensers. Each nozzle links to its tank and product, so readings, sales, and variances stay organized even on busy forecourts with many pumps running through the day.

title: Can Petroleu track petrol, diesel and HOBC nozzle readings?
description: Nozzle readings are tracked separately for petrol, diesel, and HOBC in Petroleu. Product-wise rates apply automatically, and reports break down sales by fuel type so you know which product drove the day’s revenue.

title: How does software reduce nozzle reading mistakes?
description: Petroleu validates entries, shows previous readings for reference, and calculates sales instantly. When a closing reading looks wrong, staff can catch it before closing the shift — reducing the transcription errors common with manual registers.

title: Can I check nozzle-wise sales reports?
description: Nozzle-wise sales reports are available by shift, day, or date range in Petroleu. Owners see litres sold, sale value, and variance per nozzle — useful for comparing dispenser performance and investigating unusual readings.

title: Can Petroleu show opening and closing nozzle meter readings?
description: Every shift records opening and closing meter readings per nozzle in Petroleu. Both values appear on closing sheets and stay in history, so you can review any past day’s nozzle activity whenever needed.

title: Can nozzle testing entries be recorded in Petroleu?
description: Staff can record nozzle testing quantities separately from regular sales in Petroleu. Testing litres are excluded from customer billing but still appear in stock movement, keeping your books honest during dispenser calibration and checks.

title: What is tank dipping in petrol pump software?
description: Tank dipping measures actual fuel level in underground tanks, usually with a dip stick and calibration chart. Petrol pump software compares dip readings with system stock to show gain, loss, or leakage that meter sales alone might miss.

title: How does Petroleu manage fuel tank stock?
description: Petroleu tracks opening stock, purchases, nozzle sales, and closing stock per tank. Dip entries update physical levels, and the system highlights variance between book stock and dipped stock for each product.

title: Can Petroleu calculate dip gain and dip loss?
description: When you enter a dip reading, Petroleu compares it with system stock and calculates dip gain or dip loss automatically. Recurring losses trigger investigation while gains help you understand delivery or measurement differences.

title: Can Petroleu manage multiple tanks?
description: Petroleu handles multiple underground tanks — petrol, diesel, HOBC, or CNG where applicable. Each tank has its own calibration chart, stock ledger, dip history, and variance log tied to linked nozzles.

title: Can I compare system stock with physical dip stock?
description: System stock and dipped stock appear side by side in Petroleu. The variance column makes it easy to see whether your books match what is physically in the tank after each dip or shift.

title: How does Petroleu help identify fuel shortage or leakage?
description: Repeated dip losses, nozzle variances, and stock gaps are flagged across shifts in Petroleu. Owners get a dated trail of where litres went missing — useful when investigating delivery shortfalls, recording errors, or unusual forecourt variance.

title: Can Petroleu show opening stock, purchase, sale and closing stock?

title: Can Petroleu manage fuel rate changes?
